# age payload vectors

The vectors whose outcome depends only on the age payload (`expect: success` or `expect: payload failure`, not
armored), copied unmodified from the C2SP CCTV age test kit at commit `50a8ecf2a220f4c8bdc4f085789b8e85c26829e7`
(<https://github.com/C2SP/CCTV/tree/main/age/testdata>). Header-only failure classes are omitted because the local
media format has no age header.

The vectors are available under the 0BSD, CC0 1.0 or Unlicense license, at your choice; see the upstream
`age/README.md`.
